proves.claim: Rejecting a parent reopens each claimed or submitted dependent that has an after-gate marker for it, with a note naming the parent, and leaves a plain --after dependent alone.

store.io-board-verify.reject-sends-depen.why: Without this test a rejected parent leaves work built on its rejected head open for review or still being built.

proves.claim: A dependent that already landed gets a notice fact naming the rejected parent and no reopen.

store.io-board-verify.landed-dependent-g.why: Without this test a landed dependent would be reopened or left with no word that its parent was rejected.
